<!--
Render command (use absolute paths — Quarto resolves paths relative to the notebook file):

  conda run -n quarto quarto render \
      /path/to/subspecies-phylogeny/notebooks/stage2_build.qmd \
      -P explore_dir:/absolute/path/to/run/results/01_explore \
      -P build_dir:/absolute/path/to/run/results/02_build \
      -P run_name:MyRun \
      -P highlights_file:/absolute/path/to/subspecies-phylogeny/notebooks/highlights/MyRun.yml \
      -P metadata_file:/absolute/path/to/run/genome_metadata.csv \
      -P min_freq:0.95 \
      -P skip_large_pairwise_plots:false \
      --output-dir /absolute/path/to/run/notebooks/

See notebooks/highlights/ for example highlights YAML files and their format.

Tree visualisation: uses toytree + toyplot (installed in basicpython).
  Trees are saved as SVG and interactive HTML via toyplot renderers.

Static image export for Plotly figures (PNG/SVG) requires kaleido:
    mamba install -c conda-forge python-kaleido
  Without kaleido, interactive HTML files are saved instead.
-->

```{python}
#| include: false
# ============================================================
# Imports and setup
# ============================================================
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import yaml
import toytree
import toyplot
import toyplot.html
import toyplot.svg
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots
import io
import re

warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

explore_dir = Path(explore_dir)
build_dir   = Path(build_dir)
run_name    = str(run_name)
min_freq    = str(min_freq).strip()

def _as_bool(value):
    """Parse Quarto -P boolean-ish values consistently."""
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    return str(value).strip().lower() in {"true", "1", "yes", "y"}

skip_large_pairwise_plots = _as_bool(skip_large_pairwise_plots)

figs_dir   = build_dir / "figs"   / "stage4"
tables_dir = build_dir / "tables" / "stage4"
figs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
tables_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

try:
    import kaleido  # noqa: F401
    HAS_KALEIDO = True
except ImportError:
    HAS_KALEIDO = False


def save_fig(fig_plotly, stem):
    if fig_plotly is None:
        return
    fig_plotly.write_html(str(figs_dir / f"{stem}.html"))
    if HAS_KALEIDO:
        fig_plotly.write_image(str(figs_dir / f"{stem}.svg"))
        fig_plotly.write_image(str(figs_dir / f"{stem}.png"), scale=2)


def save_tree(html_str, svg_str, stem):
    (figs_dir / f"{stem}.html").write_text(html_str)
    (figs_dir / f"{stem}.svg").write_text(svg_str)


PLOTLY_LAYOUT = dict(
    template='plotly_white',
    font=dict(family='Arial, sans-serif', size=13),
)


def display_note_callout(title, body_html):
    display(HTML(
        '<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-note callout-titled">'
        '<div class="callout-header"><div class="callout-icon-container">'
        '<i class="callout-icon"></i></div>'
        f'<div class="callout-title-container flex-fill">{title}</div></div>'
        '<div class="callout-body-container callout-body">'
        f'{body_html}'
        '</div></div>'
    ))
```

```{python}
#| include: false
# ============================================================
# Load highlights config
# ============================================================
# Default palette cycled when a highlight entry has no explicit color
_DEFAULT_PALETTE = ['#e63946', '#f4a261', '#2a9d8f', '#8338ec', '#fb8500']

highlights = {}   # name -> {'label': str, 'color': str}

_hf = str(highlights_file).strip()
if _hf:
    _path = Path(_hf)
    if _path.exists():
        _cfg = yaml.safe_load(_path.read_text()) or {}
        for i, entry in enumerate(_cfg.get('highlights', [])):
            name  = str(entry['name'])
            label = str(entry.get('label', name))
            color = str(entry.get('color', _DEFAULT_PALETTE[i % len(_DEFAULT_PALETTE)]))
            highlights[name] = {'label': label, 'color': color}
    else:
        import warnings as _w
        _w.warn(f"highlights_file not found: {_path}")


DEFAULT_TIP_COLOR  = '#457b9d'
DEFAULT_TIP_SIZE   = 5
HIGHLIGHT_TIP_SIZE = 9
METADATA_TIP_SIZE  = 7
METADATA_STYLES = {
    'isolate': {'label': 'Isolate', 'color': '#1b9e77', 'symbol': 'I'},
    'MAG': {'label': 'MAG', 'color': '#7570b3', 'symbol': 'M'},
}

genome_metadata_classes = {}  # normalized sample name -> isolate|MAG
genome_metadata_status = "not provided"
genome_metadata_counts = {}


def sample_key(name):
    key = str(name).strip()
    key = re.sub(r'\.(fa|fasta|fna)$', '', key, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    return re.sub(r'\.\d+$', '', key)


def _class_from_isolate(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return None
    return 'isolate' if _as_bool(value) else 'MAG'


_mf_meta = str(metadata_file).strip()
if _mf_meta:
    _metadata_path = Path(_mf_meta)
    if _metadata_path.exists():
        try:
            _metadata_df = pd.read_csv(_metadata_path)
            _metadata_cols = {c.lower(): c for c in _metadata_df.columns}
            if {'sample', 'isolate'}.issubset(_metadata_cols):
                _sample_col = _metadata_cols['sample']
                _isolate_col = _metadata_cols['isolate']
                for _, _row in _metadata_df.iterrows():
                    _cls = _class_from_isolate(_row[_isolate_col])
                    if _cls:
                        genome_metadata_classes[sample_key(_row[_sample_col])] = _cls
                genome_metadata_counts = dict(
                    pd.Series(list(genome_metadata_classes.values())).value_counts()
                )
                genome_metadata_status = (
                    f"loaded {len(genome_metadata_classes)} sample annotations "
                    f"from {_metadata_path}"
                )
            else:
                genome_metadata_status = (
                    f"ignored {_metadata_path} because it lacks sample/isolate columns"
                )
        except Exception as exc:
            genome_metadata_status = f"ignored {_metadata_path}: {exc}"
    else:
        genome_metadata_status = f"not found: {_metadata_path}"


def metadata_class(name):
    return (
        genome_metadata_classes.get(str(name).strip())
        or genome_metadata_classes.get(sample_key(name))
    )


ref_name = None
ref_name_source = "not found"


def is_ref_sample(name):
    return bool(
        ref_name
        and (
            str(name).strip() == str(ref_name).strip()
            or sample_key(name) == sample_key(ref_name)
        )
    )


def tip_color(name):
    if name in highlights:
        return highlights[name]['color']
    _cls = metadata_class(name)
    if _cls:
        return METADATA_STYLES[_cls]['color']
    return DEFAULT_TIP_COLOR


def tip_size(name):
    if name in highlights:
        return HIGHLIGHT_TIP_SIZE
    if metadata_class(name):
        return METADATA_TIP_SIZE
    return DEFAULT_TIP_SIZE


def sample_display_label(name, html=False, include_ref=True):
    label = str(name)
    prefix = []
    if include_ref and is_ref_sample(name):
        prefix.append('★')
    _cls = metadata_class(name)
    if _cls:
        prefix.append(METADATA_STYLES[_cls]['symbol'])
    text = f"{' '.join(prefix)} {label}".strip()
    if html and _cls:
        color = METADATA_STYLES[_cls]['color']
        return f"<span style='color:{color}'>{text}</span>"
    if html and name in highlights:
        return f"<b>{text}</b>"
    return text
```

```{python}
#| include: false
# ============================================================
# Locate files for the chosen min_freq
# ============================================================
mf_label = f"min_freq_{min_freq}"

iqtree_no_gubbins_dir = build_dir / "iqtree" / "no_gubbins" / mf_label
iqtree_gubbins_dir    = build_dir / "iqtree" / "gubbins"    / mf_label
gubbins_dir           = build_dir / "gubbins" / mf_label

HAS_GUBBINS_TREE = (iqtree_gubbins_dir / "tree.treefile").exists()
HAS_GUBBINS_OUT  = gubbins_dir.exists() and any(gubbins_dir.glob("*.per_branch_statistics.csv"))


def load_iqtree_meta(iqtree_file):
    meta = {}
    if not iqtree_file.exists():
        return meta
    text = iqtree_file.read_text()
    for label, pattern in [
        ('n_sequences',   r'Input data:\s+(\d+) sequences'),
        ('n_sites',       r'Input data:.*with (\d+) nucleotide sites'),
        ('model',         r'Model of substitution:\s+(\S+)'),
        ('log_likelihood',r'Log-likelihood of the tree:\s+([-\d.]+)'),
        ('tree_length',   r'Total tree length \(sum of branch lengths\):\s+([\d.]+)'),
        ('constant_sites',r'Number of constant sites:\s+(\d+)'),
        ('parsimony_inf', r'Number of parsimony informative sites:\s+(\d+)'),
    ]:
        m = re.search(pattern, text)
        if m:
            meta[label] = m.group(1)
    return meta


no_gubbins_meta = load_iqtree_meta(iqtree_no_gubbins_dir / "tree.iqtree")
gubbins_meta    = load_iqtree_meta(iqtree_gubbins_dir    / "tree.iqtree") if HAS_GUBBINS_TREE else {}


def load_gubbins_stats():
    if not HAS_GUBBINS_OUT:
        return None
    csv_files = list(gubbins_dir.glob("*.per_branch_statistics.csv"))
    df = pd.read_csv(csv_files[0], sep='\t')
    return df[~df['Node'].str.match(r'^Node_\d+$', na=False)].copy()


gubbins_stats = load_gubbins_stats()

n_recomb_blocks = 0
if HAS_GUBBINS_OUT:
    gff_files = list(gubbins_dir.glob("*.recombination_predictions.gff"))
    if gff_files:
        with open(gff_files[0]) as fh:
            n_recomb_blocks = sum(1 for l in fh if l.strip() and not l.startswith('#'))
```

```{python}
#| include: false
# ============================================================
# Tree drawing helpers
# ============================================================

def _tip_style_lists(tt):
    tips = tt.get_tip_labels()
    colors = [tip_color(t) for t in tips]
    sizes  = [tip_size(t)  for t in tips]
    return tips, colors, sizes


def _support_node_style(tt):
    """Per-node colours and sizes for internal bootstrap nodes."""
    tips_set = set(tt.get_tip_labels())
    node_colors, node_sizes = [], []
    node_data = tt.get_node_data()
    has_support = 'support' in node_data.columns

    for i in range(tt.nnodes):
        name = node_data['name'].iloc[i] if 'name' in node_data.columns else ''
        if name in tips_set or i < tt.ntips:
            node_colors.append(tip_color(str(name)))
            node_sizes.append(tip_size(str(name)))
        else:
            sup = node_data['support'].iloc[i] if has_support else None
            if sup is None or pd.isna(sup):
                node_colors.append('#aaaaaa'); node_sizes.append(0)
            elif sup >= 95:
                node_colors.append('#2d6a4f'); node_sizes.append(6)
            elif sup >= 70:
                node_colors.append('#f4a261'); node_sizes.append(5)
            else:
                node_colors.append('#aaaaaa'); node_sizes.append(0)
    return node_colors, node_sizes


def _render_toytree(canvas):
    html_io = io.BytesIO()
    toyplot.html.render(canvas, html_io)
    svg_io  = io.BytesIO()
    toyplot.svg.render(canvas, svg_io)
    return html_io.getvalue().decode(), svg_io.getvalue().decode()


def draw_toytree_with_support(
    tt,
    title=None,
    tip_font_size='10px',
    width=950,
    height=None,
    show_tip_labels=True,
    compact_highlight_ticks=False,
):
    tips, tip_colors, _ = _tip_style_lists(tt)
    node_colors, node_sizes = _support_node_style(tt)
    height = height or max(500, tt.ntips * 14)

    draw_kwargs = dict(
        width=width, height=height,
        layout='r', scalebar=True,
        tip_labels=show_tip_labels,
        node_sizes=node_sizes,
        node_colors=node_colors,
        node_style={'stroke': 'none'},
    )
    if show_tip_labels:
        draw_kwargs.update(
            tip_labels_colors=tip_colors,
            tip_labels_style={'font-size': tip_font_size},
        )

    canvas, axes, mark = tt.draw(**draw_kwargs)
    if title:
        axes.label.text = title
    if compact_highlight_ticks:
        _tip_y = {tip: float(i) for i, tip in enumerate(tips)}
        _x_tip = float(np.nanmax(mark.ntable[:tt.ntips, 0]))
        _x_min = float(np.nanmin(mark.ntable[:, 0]))
        _x_span = max(_x_tip - _x_min, 1e-6)

        def _draw_tick_group(names, color, start_mult, end_mult, stroke_width):
            _ys = [_tip_y[n] for n in names if n in _tip_y]
            if not _ys:
                return
            _x0 = _x_tip + _x_span * start_mult
            _x1 = _x_tip + _x_span * end_mult
            _xs = []
            _yy = []
            for _y in _ys:
                _xs.extend([_x0, _x1, np.nan])
                _yy.extend([_y, _y, np.nan])
            axes.plot(
                _xs,
                _yy,
                color=color,
                stroke_width=stroke_width,
                opacity=0.95,
                style={'stroke-linecap': 'round'},
            )

        _isolates = [tip for tip in tips if metadata_class(tip) == 'isolate']
        _draw_tick_group(
            _isolates,
            METADATA_STYLES['isolate']['color'],
            start_mult=0.015,
            end_mult=0.085,
            stroke_width=2.2,
        )
        if ref_name:
            _ref_ticks = [tip for tip in tips if is_ref_sample(tip)] or [ref_name]
            _draw_tick_group(
                _ref_ticks,
                '#d62728',
                start_mult=0.010,
                end_mult=0.145,
                stroke_width=4.0,
            )
    return _render_toytree(canvas)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
# ============================================================
# Load and render trees
# ============================================================
tt_no_gubbins = tt_gubbins = None
tt_no_gubbins_html = tt_no_gubbins_svg = ""
tt_gubbins_html    = tt_gubbins_svg    = ""
tt_no_gubbins_compact_html = tt_no_gubbins_compact_svg = ""
tt_gubbins_compact_html    = tt_gubbins_compact_svg    = ""

if (iqtree_no_gubbins_dir / "tree.treefile").exists():
    tt_no_gubbins = toytree.tree(str(iqtree_no_gubbins_dir / "tree.treefile")).ladderize()

if HAS_GUBBINS_TREE:
    tt_gubbins = toytree.tree(str(iqtree_gubbins_dir / "tree.treefile")).ladderize()

_known_tree_names = []
for _tree in [tt_no_gubbins, tt_gubbins]:
    if _tree is not None:
        _known_tree_names.extend(_tree.get_tip_labels())
_known_tree_names = list(dict.fromkeys(_known_tree_names))

_ref_fa = explore_dir / "ska2" / "map" / "reference.fa"
if _ref_fa.exists():
    with open(_ref_fa) as _fh:
        _hdr = _fh.readline().strip().lstrip('>')
    _ref_candidate = re.sub(r'\.fa(sta)?$', '', _hdr.split()[0])
    _ref_matches = [
        name for name in _known_tree_names
        if name == _ref_candidate or sample_key(name) == sample_key(_ref_candidate)
    ]
    if _ref_matches:
        ref_name = _ref_matches[0]
        ref_name_source = "reference.fa"

if ref_name is None:
    _fastani_path = explore_dir / "fastani" / "fastani.txt"
    if _fastani_path.exists():
        _fastani_df = pd.read_csv(
            _fastani_path,
            sep='\t',
            names=['query', 'ref', 'ani', 'mapped_kmers', 'total_kmers'],
        )
        for _col in ('query', 'ref'):
            _fastani_df[_col] = _fastani_df[_col].str.replace(
                r'\.fa(sta)?$', '', regex=True
            )
        _ani_matrix = _fastani_df.pivot_table(
            index='query', columns='ref', values='ani', aggfunc='first'
        )
        _ani_samples = sorted(_fastani_df['query'].unique())
        for _s in _ani_samples:
            for _t in _ani_samples:
                if pd.isna(_ani_matrix.loc[_s, _t]) and not pd.isna(_ani_matrix.loc[_t, _s]):
                    _ani_matrix.loc[_s, _t] = _ani_matrix.loc[_t, _s]
        _ani_matrix = _ani_matrix.reindex(index=_ani_samples, columns=_ani_samples)
        _diag = _ani_matrix.copy().astype(float)
        np.fill_diagonal(_diag.values, np.nan)
        _medoid_candidate = _diag.mean(axis=1).idxmax()
        _medoid_matches = [
            name for name in _known_tree_names
            if name == _medoid_candidate or sample_key(name) == sample_key(_medoid_candidate)
        ]
        ref_name = _medoid_matches[0] if _medoid_matches else _medoid_candidate
        ref_name_source = "FastANI medoid"

if tt_no_gubbins is not None:
    tt_no_gubbins_html, tt_no_gubbins_svg = draw_toytree_with_support(
        tt_no_gubbins,
        title=f"IQ-TREE ML — no Gubbins masking — {run_name} (min_freq={min_freq})"
    )
    save_tree(tt_no_gubbins_html, tt_no_gubbins_svg, "iqtree_no_gubbins")
    tt_no_gubbins_compact_html, tt_no_gubbins_compact_svg = draw_toytree_with_support(
        tt_no_gubbins,
        title=f"IQ-TREE ML — no Gubbins masking, compact unlabeled view — {run_name} (min_freq={min_freq})",
        height=1300,
        show_tip_labels=False,
        compact_highlight_ticks=True,
    )
    save_tree(
        tt_no_gubbins_compact_html,
        tt_no_gubbins_compact_svg,
        "iqtree_no_gubbins_compact",
    )

if tt_gubbins is not None:
    tt_gubbins_html, tt_gubbins_svg = draw_toytree_with_support(
        tt_gubbins,
        title=f"IQ-TREE ML — Gubbins-masked — {run_name} (min_freq={min_freq})"
    )
    save_tree(tt_gubbins_html, tt_gubbins_svg, "iqtree_gubbins")
    tt_gubbins_compact_html, tt_gubbins_compact_svg = draw_toytree_with_support(
        tt_gubbins,
        title=f"IQ-TREE ML — Gubbins-masked, compact unlabeled view — {run_name} (min_freq={min_freq})",
        height=1300,
        show_tip_labels=False,
        compact_highlight_ticks=True,
    )
    save_tree(tt_gubbins_compact_html, tt_gubbins_compact_svg, "iqtree_gubbins_compact")
```

```{python}
# ============================================================
# Branch-length distribution
# ============================================================
fig_bl = None
if tt_no_gubbins is not None:
    node_data  = tt_no_gubbins.get_node_data()
    bl_series  = node_data['dist'].dropna()
    bl_series  = bl_series[bl_series > 0]
    tip_labels = set(tt_no_gubbins.get_tip_labels())

    fig_bl = go.Figure()
    fig_bl.add_trace(go.Histogram(
        x=bl_series, nbinsx=60,
        name='All branches',
        marker_color='#457b9d', opacity=0.75,
    ))
    # Vertical lines for each highlighted strain
    if 'name' in node_data.columns:
        for name, info in highlights.items():
            mask = node_data['name'] == name
            if mask.any():
                bl_val = node_data.loc[mask, 'dist'].values[0]
                if bl_val > 0:
                    fig_bl.add_vline(
                        x=bl_val,
                        line_color=info['color'], line_width=2, line_dash='dash',
                        annotation_text=info['label'],
                        annotation_position="top right",
                    )
    fig_bl.update_layout(
        title=f"Branch-length distribution — {run_name}",
        xaxis_title="Branch length (substitutions/site)",
        yaxis_title="Count",
        **PLOTLY_LAYOUT,
    )
    save_fig(fig_bl, "branch_lengths")
```

```{python}
# Gubbins per-tip statistics
# ============================================================
fig_gubbins = None
if gubbins_stats is not None and len(gubbins_stats) > 0:
    gs = gubbins_stats.sort_values('Total SNPs', ascending=True)
    tip_names  = gs['Node'].tolist()
    bar_colors = [tip_color(t) for t in tip_names]
    tip_labels = [sample_display_label(t) for t in tip_names]

    fig_gubbins = make_subplots(
        rows=1, cols=2,
        subplot_titles=["Total SNPs per tip", "SNPs in recombinations per tip"],
        horizontal_spacing=0.12,
    )
    fig_gubbins.add_trace(go.Bar(
        y=tip_labels, x=gs['Total SNPs'],
        orientation='h', marker_color=bar_colors, name='Total SNPs',
        customdata=tip_names,
        hovertemplate='%{customdata}<br>Total SNPs: %{x}<extra></extra>',
    ), row=1, col=1)
    fig_gubbins.add_trace(go.Bar(
        y=tip_labels, x=gs['Number of SNPs Inside Recombinations'],
        orientation='h', marker_color=bar_colors, name='SNPs in recombinations',
        customdata=tip_names,
        hovertemplate='%{customdata}<br>SNPs in recomb: %{x}<extra></extra>',
    ), row=1, col=2)
    fig_gubbins.update_layout(
        height=max(500, len(gs) * 14),
        title=f"Gubbins per-tip statistics — {run_name} (min_freq={min_freq})",
        showlegend=False,
        **PLOTLY_LAYOUT,
    )
    fig_gubbins.update_xaxes(title_text="SNPs", row=1, col=1)
    fig_gubbins.update_xaxes(title_text="SNPs", row=1, col=2)
    save_fig(fig_gubbins, "gubbins_per_tip")
    gubbins_stats.to_csv(tables_dir / "gubbins_per_tip.csv", index=False)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
# ============================================================
# Pairwise ML distance heatmap
# ============================================================
fig_dist = None
if not skip_large_pairwise_plots and (iqtree_no_gubbins_dir / "tree.mldist").exists():
    dist_df = pd.read_csv(
        iqtree_no_gubbins_dir / "tree.mldist",
        sep=r'\s+', header=None, skiprows=1, index_col=0,
    )
    dist_df.columns = dist_df.index

    if tt_no_gubbins is not None:
        leaf_order = tt_no_gubbins.get_tip_labels()
        order = [t for t in leaf_order if t in dist_df.index]
        dist_df = dist_df.reindex(index=order, columns=order)

    tip_names   = list(dist_df.index)
    text_matrix = [[f"Query: {r}<br>Ref: {c}<br>Dist: {dist_df.loc[r,c]:.6f}"
                    for c in tip_names] for r in tip_names]
    ticktext_x  = [sample_display_label(t, html=True) for t in tip_names]
    ticktext_y  = [sample_display_label(t, html=True) for t in tip_names]

    fig_dist = go.Figure(go.Heatmap(
        z=dist_df.values, x=tip_names, y=tip_names,
        text=text_matrix, hoverinfo='text',
        colorscale='Blues', colorbar=dict(title="ML distance"),
    ))
    fig_dist.update_layout(
        title=f"IQ-TREE pairwise ML distances — {run_name} (min_freq={min_freq})",
        xaxis=dict(tickfont=dict(size=9), tickangle=45, ticktext=ticktext_x, tickvals=tip_names),
        yaxis=dict(tickfont=dict(size=9), ticktext=ticktext_y, tickvals=tip_names, autorange='reversed'),
        height=800,
        **PLOTLY_LAYOUT,
    )
    save_fig(fig_dist, "pairwise_distances")
    dist_df.to_csv(tables_dir / "pairwise_ml_distances.csv")
```
